name: Thomas Caskey
tagline: I build innovative, customer-driven, native-first apps, where quality lives in the code and in the experience.
bio: I'm a mobile developer with over ten years of experience, at my best working alongside product and design to solve real-world problems. I worked on some of Aotearoa New Zealand's most used apps at Alphero, led the mobile platform at Sharesies, and now build features for the Education team at Goodnotes from Amsterdam.
I care about creating a safe and open place to work, where diversity is advocated for and the culture supports both personal and professional growth.
facts: BSc Computer Science, Victoria University of Wellington
